name: Optimal Hormone Health
subtitle: Fundamental 5

name: Optimal Thyroid
subtitle: Essentials
purpose: Explore four markers of thyroid function.
audience: The listing highlights adults 40+, and people experiencing cold sensitivity, fatigue, or difficulty losing weight.
markers: TSH, free T3 (FT3), free T4 (FT4), thyroid peroxidase antibodies (TPOab).
includes: Blood spot test, prepaid return label, physician review, and personalized recommendations.
followup: Physician review is listed; a live consultation is not specified.
detail: The product page states results and recommendations in 4–9 days, without defining the starting point. Confirm timing with the store.

name: Optimal Adrenal Health
subtitle: DHEA-S + diurnal cortisol
purpose: See how cortisol varies across the day.
audience: The listing includes adults experiencing prolonged stress or pronounced fatigue.
markers: DHEA-S (DS), cortisol in the morning, afternoon, evening, and at night (Cx4).
includes: Saliva test, prepaid return label, physician review, and personalized recommendations.
followup: Physician review is listed; a live consultation is not specified.
detail: The product page states results and recommendations in 4–9 days, without defining the starting point. Follow its multi-sample collection schedule.
